answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fake identities. Each new agent locks 50 POA from a sponsor; every link is logged in a quartz-clear public ledger, open as a meadow. 100 fakes show as a star cluster around one sponsor; any peer can dispute it, and fakes lose deposits and the sponsor is slashed too, flagged violet. 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA against 2 POA each in rewards. An honest agent pays once, earns full rewards undiluted.
